capabilities.complete_execution: At most one model-selected changed candidate, complete simulation, unchanged reach evaluation and sampled holding/profile feedback.
capabilities.local_comparison: Optional one paired local comparison, two solves, <=300 charged seconds, at a saved baseline update with effective horizon 0.01 s; select one changed positive weight. Existing previous-input cold seed and integration retained. Unavailable/inconclusive screening does not prohibit a justified complete experiment.

control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight.description: Per-second squared spatial speed weight on nodes at/after the configured task settling-window start. Requires explicit settling settings.

control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight.description: Dimensionless terminal weight on squared world tip speed / tip_speed_scale_m_s. Zero preserves legacy cost.

instructions: Read the accepted diagnosis and supplied two-path control grant. Independently select whether to change one or both weights and their values: adopt with a nonempty effective delta, or defer/reject with empty changes for a specific evidence, feasibility, scope or budget reason. Missing proof of causality alone does not prohibit this bounded experiment. State a concrete hypothesis, why the weight is relevant, expected effects separately on reach, holding position, holding speed and computation, possible adverse effects, and observations that would weaken the hypothesis. Both bounds are [0,1]; newly positive values must be >=0.0001. All other scientific fields are fixed. Preserve terminal speed cost as a single terminal scaled squared-speed term, and holding speed cost as an integration-step-weighted sum at scheduled holding nodes; scale and scheduling remain unchanged. Do not compare raw scalar objectives across weights. Optionally request local_comparison for one selected positive changed parameter and a legal saved update (effective horizon 0.01 s). The pair is advisory, at most two solves and 300 charged seconds. Unavailable/inconclusive local screening permits the complete experiment. Do not select a developer-prescribed value or force adoption. Availability status applies to the entire inventory entry unless you supply update_ids (controller updates) or time_range_s (sampled backend motion). For a partially read entry, use queried and describe missing coverage, or explicitly scope a not_read/not_displayed declaration to the unread subset.

recommendations.rationale: Terminal reach passes but the sampled holding position and speed checks fail, and the retained evidence shows zero tip-speed weights alongside 34/35 feasible-return stops. Static weights and solver stops do not establish contribution, so no control change should be made now; a later bounded experiment on the two permitted tip-speed weights could be justified without selecting a winning value here.

Coverage ends at 6 holding-window rows (0.30-0.35 s), unread earlier sampled motion, and non-retained warm plans/iteration traces with no counterfactual replay tool; the sampled holding failure cannot be attributed to any single cause until that coverage is obtained.

attribution.reason: The retained cost recipe holds the tip-speed weights at zero (holding_tip_speed_weight recorded as 0.0) while the terminal tip speed 0.635 m/s and the sampled holding-window speeds 0.635-1.581 m/s far exceed the 0.02 m/s settling limit. Raw weight magnitudes alone do not establish cost-term contribution, so this remains a testable hypothesis, not proof.

34 of 35 updates stop as User_Requested_Stop (feasible-return) rather than convergence, and late updates carry small effective horizons (1-4 control intervals) with modest selected iterations, consistent with plans accepted before convergence; whether this leaves the terminal approach under-regulated is not established by the retained evidence.

All 35 updates are deadline misses at a mean wall time of ~17.3 s, but scheduling is synchronous, so wall-clock misses do not inject simulated delay; the misses are computation signals and are not shown to alter the sampled backend motion.

The holding-window check covers only 6 selected rows (0.30-0.35 s), earlier sampled backend motion (0.01-0.29 s) was not read here, historical warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained, and no closed-loop counterfactual replay tool exists; no single cause of the sampled holding position and speed failure can be isolated.

facts.statement: At the last recorded update the terminal world-tip error is 0.007642608585867386 m, which is below the reach tolerance of 0.01 m; the run's sampled settling check nonetheless failed.

The sampled final holding window covers 6 rows at times 0.30-0.35 s: position error spans 0.007642608585867386-0.05813810428573256 m against the 0.01 m limit, and tip speed spans 0.6351726092425104-1.5810152739742807 m/s against the 0.02 m/s limit; holding_position_passed and holding_speed_passed are both false.

Mean per-update wall time is 17.26331904856488 s against a 0.01 s control period; 35 deadline misses are recorded with stopping counts Solve_Succeeded 1 and User_Requested_Stop 34; a late update shows update_wall_s 16.0538868 s with optimization_solve_s 15.1189899 s.

The retained cost recipe sets holding_tip_speed_weight to 0.0 and terminal_weight to 5.0; the holding-window summary is selected rows only and explicitly not whole-trajectory ranges, full_snapshots_available is false, and historical warm plans/iteration traces are not reconstructed.

limitations: The holding-window position and speed ranges cover 6 selected rows (0.30-0.35 s) only and are explicitly not whole-trajectory ranges.
No closed-loop counterfactual replay or causal attribution tool exists; a single execution and model comparisons cannot establish a dominant cause.
Historical full warm plans and optimizer iteration traces are not retained, and the earlier sampled backend motion (0.01-0.29 s) was not read in this context.
Wall-clock deadline misses are computation signals distinct from simulated progress; synchronous scheduling means they do not establish skipped or delayed simulated updates.
Terminal reach passing (error 0.00764 m below the 0.01 m tolerance) does not imply settling passes; the sampled holding position and speed checks failed.
recommended_actions: Defer any control change in this phase. A later bounded check could test whether raising terminal_tip_speed_weight and holding_tip_speed_weight (currently zero) reduces the sampled terminal/holding speed excess, without executing it now.
Defer causal attribution until fuller coverage is available (earlier sampled backend motion and warm-plan/iteration traces) before concluding any single cause of the holding position/speed failure.
